# mimecast_dmarc_vendors (Data Source)

Read the DMARC Analyzer vendor catalogue or one vendor by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_dmarc_vendors" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `vendor_id` (String) Optional vendor ID for a detail lookup. Omit to list every vendor with cursor pagination.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable DMARC vendor inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Vendor category.
- `dkim_selectors` (Set of String) Vendor DKIM selectors.
- `hostnames` (Set of String) Vendor hostnames.
- `id` (String) Vendor ID.
- `instructions` (String) Vendor configuration instructions URL.
- `name` (String) Vendor name.
- `spf_includes` (Set of String) Vendor SPF include terms.
- `status` (String) Vendor association status.
